title: Approval request
description: What the engine's local pages serve at GET /api/v1/approvals/{approvalId}, and what a format 1 approval link carries, <base>/approvals/<approvalId>#1.<base64url(deflate-raw(this JSON))>, which the pages still read. The engine writes format 2 (compact-request.schema.json). See CONTRACT.md, Approvals and Page links.

binding.description: The binding text exactly as Postgres returned it (binding.schema.json). The passkey signs sha256 of its UTF-8 bytes.

lines.description: Preview lines exactly as Postgres returned them, in order (preview-line.schema.json). sha256 of the lines joined by a newline must equal the binding's rowsHash.

revealNonce.description: Planned (HR-1). The approval's current single-use reveal nonce, 16 bytes base64url, which a reveal proof signs. The column exists from basalt_meta version 29, but the engine serves it, and an approval reveal, only once version 30 is installed (open_reveal, reveal_approval_rows). Served only by the engine at GET /api/v1/approvals/{approvalId} (read with basalt_meta.reveal_nonce), never carried in a long link: a long link cannot reveal. See CONTRACT.md, Approvals, Rows hidden from the agent.

columns.description: Display only, never signed: each table the lines name (as they spell it) to its column names in table order (pg_attribute attnum, as the agent role reads the catalog). Served only by the engine, never carried in a long link. The page orders a table's columns by it, any column not listed after them in the order the rows carry; without it (a long link) the rows' order. See CONTRACT.md, Local pages.

credentialIds.description: Registered passkey credential ids, base64url, used as allowCredentials. May be empty.
